High-level summary:
- Vertical: payment processing + B2B healthcare claims support (agents handle PHI/PCI). Heavy regulation.

- 6-week VPC POC using 4 dedicated GPU nodes, canary to hosted for fallbacks.

- Integrations: Genesys Cloud + ServiceNow tool-calling preferred.
